verdict.rationale: Official docs confirm that Copilot Mobile exists on both iOS and Android, and that connectors (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google services) work there just as on Copilot.com. That shows real apps with at least some feature parity. However, this is a single passing mention: nothing documents the mobile apps' broader feature set, so 'full-featured' is not established. Missing for 10: documentation of the mobile feature set (voice, vision, Researcher/Analyst, Cowork) on iOS/Android, explicit statements of web/desktop parity, and independent or hands-on reports of the mobile apps.
